may-generate-new.meaning: Generator may create new original media. assetRef must be generated:<id> or placeholder:<id>.

placeholder-only.meaning: No real asset and no generated likeness. assetRef must be placeholder:<id>.

must-not-reproduce.meaning: Real trademark or proprietary brand media: never reused, traced, recreated or imitated. assetRef must be placeholder:<id>.

omit.meaning: No placeholder or generated stand-in exists. Only the real file in clone mode (source:<path>); blocked in generation mode.

operator-supplied.meaning: The deploying operator supplies its own asset (its logo, its document, its verified emblem). assetRef must be user:<id> or placeholder:<id>; the generator never fabricates it.

licensingNote: Source is the live site of a real company (The Equator Company, equatorcompany.com). Real people's names/photos, partner/merger/member logos, client project slides, brand Lotties/videos, the PRR PDF and the National 2 font are not licensed for reuse in generated output. A real logo or wordmark is never must-reuse-exact in generation mode: it is clone-only and generation uses placeholder-brand-mark or user-supplied-asset.

brand-wordmark.description: The Equator Company wordmark (header 352x34, footer stacked 276x180). Real trademark.
brand-wordmark.generatedModeGuidance: Use placeholder-brand-mark (neutral text-free shape) or the operator's own mark via user-supplied-asset. Never redraw, trace or imitate the Equator wordmark.

brand-lottie-splash.generatedModeGuidance: A neutral placeholder mark or an original generated animation; never a recreation of navbar.lottie.

brand-lottie-value.generatedModeGuidance: Original generated illustrations/animations per panel; never the five Equator value animations.

brand-lottie-footer.generatedModeGuidance: Original generated loop or a placeholder mark; never footer.lottie.

ambient-video.description: Ambient looping background video slot (title: screen blend over coral; CTA: under oat multiply). New original footage may be generated; the brand's bird_low.mp4 / cloud_low.mp4 must never be reused.
ambient-video.generatedModeGuidance: Use generated-ambient-video (new original footage, no identifiable people, places or brands); never bird_low.mp4 / cloud_low.mp4.

merger-logo.description: Logos of the four real merged companies in the story section. Real third-party trademarks.
merger-logo.generatedModeGuidance: Fictional or placeholder company marks only; never the S317, Sair da Casca, Engidro or Factor Social logos.

member-logo.description: 'Proud member of' marquee logos (logo1-9.png). Real third-party trademarks.
member-logo.generatedModeGuidance: Placeholder association marks only; membership claims are operator-verified.

project-photo.description: Our Work slide photography. New imagery may be generated provided it depicts no identifiable real person, client, brand or site; the real client project photos (slides/slide1-5) must never be reused.
project-photo.generatedModeGuidance: Generated original imagery with no identifiable person, client, brand or site, a placeholder, or the operator's own project photography; never slides/slide1-5.

team-portrait.description: Real employees' portraits (15 people). Never reuse, never generate a likeness: neutral placeholder only.
team-portrait.generatedModeGuidance: Fictional avatars of fictional people only; never a real employee's photo or a generated likeness of one.

team-halftone.description: Halftone 'back' images derived from the real employees' portraits. Still a likeness: placeholder only.
team-halftone.generatedModeGuidance: Fictional avatar treatment; never a halftone derived from a real portrait.

funding-emblem.description: PRR / Republica Portuguesa / EU funding strip (mono.svg). Reproducing it would falsely claim public funding: the field must be absent.
funding-emblem.generatedModeGuidance: Absent unless the operator really holds public funding and supplies its own official emblem (user-supplied-asset). Never the PRR / Republica Portuguesa / EU strip.

project-sheet-pdf.description: The company's PRR project sheet PDF. Real proprietary document: never linked or bundled; the field must be absent.
project-sheet-pdf.generatedModeGuidance: Absent unless the operator supplies its own document. Never link or bundle Equator-PRR-Investimentos.pdf.

placeholder-brand-mark.description: Neutral, text-free placeholder in the brand-mark slot (header logo, stacked footer wordmark, splash mark).
placeholder-brand-mark.generatedModeGuidance: Use a neutral shape; replace with the operator's own mark later.

user-supplied-asset.description: An asset the deploying operator supplies and owns: its own logo, project photography, funding emblem or document.
user-supplied-asset.generatedModeGuidance: Reference it as user:<id>; never fabricate it.

generated-illustration.description: Original generated illustration or animation (value panels, splash/footer loops, project imagery).
generated-illustration.generatedModeGuidance: Original artwork only: no tracing or imitation of Equator Lotties, no identifiable real person, client, brand or site.

generated-ambient-video.description: Original generated ambient footage for the title and CTA background slots.
generated-ambient-video.generatedModeGuidance: Original abstract/nature footage; no identifiable people, places or brands; never the Equator bird/cloud clips.

placeholder-screenshot.description: Neutral placeholder in an image slot (project slide image) when no original imagery exists yet.
placeholder-screenshot.generatedModeGuidance: Neutral placeholder frame; replace with operator-supplied imagery.

fictional-avatar.description: Avatar or portrait of a fictional person, used with a fictional name.
fictional-avatar.generatedModeGuidance: Fictional people only; never a real employee's likeness or name.

placeholder-company-logo.description: Placeholder company / association / customer logo slot (merger logos, member marquee).
placeholder-company-logo.generatedModeGuidance: Neutral placeholder marks with fictional or placeholder labels; never real third-party trademarks.

placeholder-url.description: Link targets in generation mode: placeholder:<id>, a relative path, an in-page anchor, or an absolute URL on a reserved .example / .invalid domain only.
placeholder-url.generatedModeGuidance: Never an Equator, partner, client, LinkedIn, Mailchimp or government URL.

original-copy.description: All text in generation mode: newly written copy for the operator's brand.
original-copy.generatedModeGuidance: Never Equator copy (checked as hashed 5-word shingles), names, claims or statistics.

font.national-2.description: National 2 (Klim Type Foundry), weights 400/500. Not an assetRole: never referenced from a PageSpec; generated output uses the token fallback stack unless the deployer holds a licence.

modes.clone: Faithful reconstruction of the Equator site. A role whose availability is clone-only or blocked-for-generation may carry assetRef source:<path> naming one of its real sourceFiles (verified against ../public when the source tree is present), or a placeholder/generated ref allowed by its generationPolicy.
modes.generation: A new page for someone else. Only generation-safe roles are allowed (GENERATION_MODE_ASSET); source: refs, real file stems and real asset identifiers are rejected; the role's generationPolicy decides which ref prefix is allowed.

availabilityValues.clone-only: Real Equator media. Usable only in clone mode; in generation mode use one of generationSafeSubstitutes.
availabilityValues.generation-safe: Safe for generation mode: placeholder, operator-supplied, generated-original or fictional content only.
availabilityValues.blocked-for-generation: Real media that would make a false or legally sensitive claim if reused (public-funding emblem, proprietary document). Clone mode only; absent from generation output unless the operator supplies its own verified equivalent (user-supplied-asset).

refPrefixes.generated:: new original media created for this page (never traced from the source)
refPrefixes.source:: a real Equator file (clone mode only); must be listed in the role's sourceFiles
